SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
